from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the party involved")
    role: str = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Defendant, Appellant, Plaintiff)")

class MonetaryDecision(BaseModel):
    amount: str = Field(description="The specific monetary amount and currency/unit")
    type: str = Field(description="Type of monetary decision (e.g., Fine, Court Fee, Compensation, Restitution)")
    context: str = Field(description="Context of the amount, e.g. who pays/receives, case reference")

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    document_identifier: str = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., 'Document 1', '判决文书 1')")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Criminal, Civil)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the court's ruling or verdict text")
    monetary_decisions: list[MonetaryDecision] = Field(description="List of fines, fees, or compensation ordered")
    confiscation_items: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of items confiscated or destroyed")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseRecord]
